d: Jet black, straight, waist-length hair flows wildly with long bangs framing the face. The visible right eye is a sharp amber gold with a focused expression, while the left eye is covered by a black eyepatch. Appearing as a mature adult with a slender build, the figure wears a crimson red blazer over a white collared blouse, paired with a black high-waisted mini skirt, a black utility belt with pouches, sheer black tights, and black criss-cross heels. A long black sword is held behind the back.
